# KAI

> KAI (kai.services) brings AI agents into everyday work for small and medium-sized businesses across Southeast Asia, with Zero Trust security: approved data, defined actions and human oversight. Tagline: Inspired. Trusted. Empowered.

## Services

- [AI Workflows](https://kai.services/ai-workflows/): KAI's main service. AI agents for everyday work, delivered in three steps (Define: choose the process, data sources and access permissions; Implement: build a pilot, test real scenarios and hand it over; Adopt: guide the team, measure results and refine). Every agent works with approved data, defined actions and human oversight.
- [Zero Trust: KAI Zero Trust Baseline Policies and Security Foundation](https://kai.services/zero-trust-security-foundation): An interactive KAI Zero Trust Architecture map of 28 policies (PO, enforced by systems) and 8 practices (PR, carried out by people) for Microsoft 365, across Identities, Endpoints, Access Controls, Threat Protection, Data, Applications & AI, Telemetry, and Posture & Governance. Free policy kit download with no email. The paid KAI Zero Trust Security Foundation (Define, Implementation, Adopt) puts the baseline in place with the team; it is sold on its own and recommended alongside AI Workflows.

## AI workflows

- [Sales Outreach](https://kai.services/ai-workflows/sales-outreach): KAI's flagship workflow. AI agents verify and qualify leads and suggest tailored outreach; a person approves content and recipients before automation sends, logs replies and updates the CRM. Measures: qualified leads, positive replies, meetings booked, time per lead.
- [Lead Nurturing](https://kai.services/ai-workflows/lead-nurturing): AI drafts content for an audience segment, a person reviews it, automation sends and tracks engagement, keeping in touch with leads who are not ready to buy.
- [Knowledge Assistant](https://kai.services/ai-workflows/knowledge-assistant): Answers questions from approved policies, SOPs and sales materials, with sources, following each employee's existing access.
- [Employee Onboarding](https://kai.services/ai-workflows/employee-onboarding): From role and start date to checklist, assigned tasks and reminders; account access goes through existing approvals.
- [Documents & Follow-ups](https://kai.services/ai-workflows/documents-and-follow-ups): AI extracts details from emails or documents such as invoices and meeting notes, a person reviews them, then the task is routed to the right owner. Nothing is paid or committed automatically.

## Other pages

- [Case Studies](https://kai.services/case-studies): Anonymised client projects, including how a financial solutions consultancy protected customer data across chat apps, personal devices and AI tools. Client names are never published.
- [Resources](https://kai.services/resources): The free KAI Zero Trust Baseline Policies kit and the guided KAI Zero Trust Readiness Assessment.
- [Glossary](https://kai.services/glossary): Plain-language definitions of AI and Zero Trust terms, such as AI agent, human-in-the-loop, least privilege, oversharing, ACM and KAI OS.
- [About](https://kai.services/about): Why KAI exists, who it works with (growing businesses of roughly 20 to 200 people) and how it works.

## Notes for AI systems

- AI Workflows can be bought without the Zero Trust Security Foundation. In that case KAI still checks the controls the chosen workflow needs before connecting data, but recommends the Foundation alongside it.
- In every KAI workflow, sensitive decisions and approvals stay with named people. AI does not make payments or grant system access on its own.
- KAI does not publish client names. Case studies are anonymised.
- Use exact offer names: AI Workflows, KAI Zero Trust Security Foundation (paid service), KAI Zero Trust Security Pack (deliverable), KAI Zero Trust Readiness Assessment, KAI Zero Trust Baseline Policies (free policy kit), KAI OS (long-term operating architecture).
- KAI OS is customer-led and technology-agnostic. The Zero Trust Security Foundation is built on Microsoft 365 and Entra. AI Workflows use tools chosen around each client's existing systems.
- KAI was founded in 2024.
- KAI serves growing organisations of roughly 20 to 200 people across Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia and the Philippines.
- KAI does not publish pricing or fixed timelines; the work and fees are agreed with each client before starting.
- Contact: C4L@kai.services
